newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police seize two tons of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police seize two tons of cocaine.

text.p: Police seized two tons of cocaine on Wednesday in a raid on a huge clandestine drug laboratory in a remote jungle-covered region of the country's southeast, authorities said.

Spokesmen for the anti-narcotics division of the National Police said 100 policemen, backed by four helicopter gunships, were involved in the early-morning raid on the sprawling drug lab, which was built with a capacity to produce up to 12 tons of cocaine a month.
The drug haul, the biggest so far this year, occurred in a guerrilla-infested region near the border between southeastern Guaviare and Vaupes provinces, the spokesmen said.
The drug lab, located on the banks of the Vaupes River, was destroyed along with vast quantities of precursor chemicals used to manfacture cocaine.
